reference_policy: One current-project APPROVED sheet (Choi, S10) used only for Gate Rescue uniform continuity. No retired or external images. The S25 lineup itself is the requested front-view sheet; no extra front image is required by this entry.

arguments.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: supporting-cast production model lineup for an original Korean hunter fantasy comic. Generate ONE landscape PNG at exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels, lossless full native resolution.

Sheet recipe: orthographic front-view full-body lineup, neutral soft studio key light from upper LEFT; fixed eye-level camera around 1.6 m, no perspective distortion. Solid uniform light-grey #E9E9EC background, no texture, no vignette, no gradient. Only soft small contact shadows beneath shoes. Exactly NINE distinct Korean adults standing side by side in ONE unbroken horizontal row with all soles on the SAME baseline, front or subtly three-quarter front. Every head, hand, shoe and held prop fully inside the canvas. Maximise the figures' height while keeping true adult anatomy: 7.5-8 heads tall, legs about half the body height, individual body builds. Tight orderly spacing, silhouettes readable; no two rows, no seated figures, no scale silhouette, no ruler, no tenth full figure. Small comfortable stance shifts and slightly different head tilts, not a group-action scene. No scene props other than the specified carried equipment.

Input image 1 is an APPROVED current-project uniform reference: copy only the Gate Rescue jacket's navy #1E2A44, hi-vis yellow-green #C8E03A and silver reflective-panel arrangement for the LAST figure. Do not duplicate that man's face, hair, coffee cup or stance. All nine subjects below are new supporting cast. The image is a design reference, not an edit target.

LEFT TO RIGHT, exactly in this order:
1. Inspector Ryu, Korean man in his fifties, about 172 cm; tired fair face, drooping brow, grey MOUSTACHE, short greying side-parted hair, reading glasses. Grey Hunter Association uniform jacket #7D838D / #5A616D with a small star-and-shield emblem without lettering, grey trousers and plain dark shoes. Thoughtful, patient expression, one hand adjusting his reading glasses, other hand resting at his side. His uniform is an inspector's zip-front jacket, not a business suit.
2. Deputy Director Hwang, Korean man age 60, about 174 cm; silver neatly combed hair, round soft smiling face, rimless glasses, clean-shaven. A formal Association grey suit #8B9099 / #676D77, white shirt, muted grey tie and plain dark dress shoes. Soft bureaucratic smile; hands gently folded at the waist. On the full figure, his lapels look normal and NO Kanghan pin is visible on their outer faces. A small silver double-hexagon pin is secretly fixed to the UNDERSIDE of his anatomical LEFT lapel.
3. Black Hound's lawyer, Korean man in his forties, about 180 cm, lean; slick black hair, sharp narrow face, cool appraising eyes, clean-shaven; expensive fitted charcoal-grey business suit #555C67 / #353E4C, white shirt, SILVER tie. Holding a slim tablet in one hand against his ribs with screen facing away so no screen is visible; other hand tucked into a trouser pocket. Plain polished dark shoes.
4. Association lobby guard, young Korean man about 24, 178 cm, athletic but ordinary build, neat short black hair, attentive face. Medium-grey Association field uniform with small star-and-shield emblem without letters, matching straight trousers and plain black boots. Holding a BLACK HANDHELD SCANNER WAND pointed down, other hand behind his back. No firearm, no holster, no extra weapons. Uniform visibly grey, unlike the police officer.
5. Kanghan spokesman, smooth Korean man about 45, 182 cm, immaculately groomed, swept dark hair, long composed face with a practiced polite public smile; NAVY business suit #25334D / #192237, white shirt, dark navy tie, small silver double-hexagon lapel pin, plain black oxfords. Both hands lightly clasped at the belt. He is standing alone in the lineup, with NO podium and no backdrop.
6. Convenience-store clerk, sleepy Korean man about 23, 170 cm, slender, messy short dark-brown hair, heavy-lidded exhausted eyes, slumped shoulders but full-length adult body; a GREEN store vest #4F866C / #365E50 over a plain pale-grey polo, charcoal trousers and simple dark slip-on shoes. One hand in a vest pocket, the other touching the back of his neck. No name tag or printed badge.
7. Ward doctor, tired young Korean man about 30, 176 cm; oval face, straight short dark hair, under-eye tired lines, no facial hair, no glasses; white knee-length doctor's coat #ECEEEF / #CAD0D7 over slate-blue scrubs, dark plain work shoes. Holding a slim tablet against his torso with its dark back facing the viewer, other hand supporting its bottom edge. No visible screen, no text, no dangling incoherent equipment.
8. Korean police officer, Korean man about 32, 177 cm, sturdy; short black hair beneath a NAVY peaked police cap with simple star-and-shield emblem without letters, serious face. NAVY uniform shirt and trousers, FLUORESCENT YELLOW-GREEN sleeveless police vest #C8E03A / #9AAB30 with SILVER reflective strips, plain black belt and boots. Hands clasped behind his back; no guns, no readable insignia. A vest over a short-sleeved navy shirt, clearly distinct from the rescue responder's long-sleeved jacket.
9. Gate Rescue Corps responder, Korean man about 40, 175 cm, broadish face, close-cropped dark hair, clean-shaven, calm kind eyes; long-sleeved navy #1E2A44 / #121C31 rescue JACKET with hi-vis yellow-green #C8E03A shoulder and sleeve panels and silver reflective bands matching the approved reference; navy trousers and plain black work boots. Holding ONE compact folded GOLD FOIL RESCUE BLANKET #CDB369 / #927B45 close against one hip, hands visibly supporting the folded bundle. No coffee cup. No helmet and no lettering.

ONE SMALL DETAIL INSET ONLY: place a clean outlined rectangular inset in the unused background ABOVE Hwang (the second figure), never covering any full figure. It shows an enlarged close-up of HIS grey anatomical LEFT lapel being lifted outward by a hand, exposing the tiny SILVER HEXAGON INSIDE A HEXAGON pin on the hidden underside of the lapel. Show the folded fabric construction clearly: plain outer face, emblem only on the reverse turned outward in the inset. This is a garment-and-hand close-up, not an additional head or full figure. No arrow, no label, no letters. All remaining background stays empty.

Use only a few crisp large cel-shadow masses per garment. Distinct faces and hair silhouettes: moustached tired inspector, round smiling silver-haired deputy, slim slick lawyer, neat young guard, polished spokesman, sleepy green-vest clerk, weary white-coat doctor, capped police officer, close-cropped rescuer. All figures keep natural shoulder widths, long adult legs, grounded feet and coherent five-finger hands. Keep the group clear at thumbnail size.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

qa.full_size: Checked all nine figures, faces, clothing, hands, equipment, full feet and shared baseline.
qa.thumbnail_200px: Checked using an in-memory PNG only; nine silhouettes and occupational colour groups remain distinct.
qa.zoom_200percent: In-memory native crop inspected at 200% for hands and edge/compression quality.
qa.hwang_inset: One garment close-up above the second figure exposes the double-hexagon on the lapel underside; main figure has no visible outside hexagon.
qa.text: No text, digits, lettered signs, labels or logos seen.
qa.proportions: Full adult bodies with small heads and long legs; no scale silhouette.
limitations: Generic characters' heights and unspecified facial details are production choices rather than new canon.
Faint light-grey background tone variation is permitted by the 27 October override.

qa_previews: In memory only; no preview or temporary image files saved in the project.
